title: Do Language Models Need a Trainable Input Embedding Table? Fixed Minimal Token Codes at 1.7B-Class Scale
abstract: arXiv:2610.04002v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A token must be identifiable before a language model can learn how to use it. Must its input coordinates also be learned? We replace the trainable input table of a decoder-only Transformer with a predetermined 16-bit identifier for each of 49,152 tokens. Repetition lifts the code to width 2048 without a learned projection. We train five models from scratch to 100B prediction targets each: a learned-input control and four fixed-input variants using canonical codes, an invertible recoding, an extra Transformer block, or row-normalized codes. At the endpoint, the four fixed-input models attain 51.44-53.34% HellaSwag normalized accuracy, 70.46-71.49% PIQA accuracy, and 42.29-44.52% LAMBADA accuracy. The normalized model attains the upper endpoint on all three; the learned control scores 57.79%, 72.69%, and 47.72%, respectively. At unchanged depth and parameter count, the normalized model's LAMBADA advantage over canonical codes is 1.80 p

translated_title: 语言模型需要可训练的输入嵌入表吗？17亿参数级规模下的固定最小标记编码
translated_abstract: 在语言模型学习如何使用一个标记之前，该标记必须能够被识别。那么它的输入坐标是否也必须通过学习获得？我们将解码器专用Transformer的可训练输入表替换为预先确定的16位标识符，为49,152个标记中的每一个分配固定编码，并通过重复将编码提升至2048宽度，而无需任何学习到的投影。我们从零开始训练了五个模型，每个模型训练至1000亿个预测目标：一个可学习输入的对照组，以及四个固定输入的变体——分别使用规范编码、可逆重编码、额外的Transformer块或行归一化编码。在训练终点，四个固定输入模型分别达到51.44%-53.34%的HellaSwag归一化准确率、70.46%-71.49%的PIQA准确率以及42.29%-44.52%的LAMBADA准确率。其中行归一化模型在全部三项基准上均达到固定输入变体的上限；而可学习输入的对照组分别取得57.79%、72.69%和47.72%的成绩。在深度和参数数量保持不变的情况下，行归一化模型相比规范编码在LAMBADA上的优势为1.80个百分点。
tldr: 该研究证明在17亿参数规模下，语言模型的输入嵌入表可以完全用固定的16位标记编码（通过重复扩展至2048维）替代可训练嵌入，仅产生几个百分点的性能差距，其中行归一化编码在固定输入方案中表现最佳。
en_tdlr: At 1.7B-parameter scale, language models can replace trainable input embedding tables with fixed 16-bit token codes (expanded to width 2048 via repetition), incurring only a few percentage points of performance loss, with row-normalized codes performing best among the fixed-input variants.
